name: Build once, verify, reuse
summary: A proven query gap may produce a reusable capability; unsupported data is not fixed by inventing a query.

steps.label: Decide whether a query is missing
steps.human: Select the bounded build outcome only when source data is supported and no offered query fits. Do not write the request.

steps.label: Construct the scoped request
steps.human: Assemble original need, input/output requirements and source-fit evidence; deduplicate equivalent active builds and dispatch the coding agent. A data gap is not a query build.

steps.label: Build a candidate query
steps.human:
Author a parameterized bounded query and its self-describing input/output contract, tests and reviewed evaluation cases. Preserve the question and source context for resumption.

Current bounded recipe compilation is an implementation baseline; the outstanding proper-query authoring architecture decision is not silently resolved here.
produces: A candidate query plus verification material

steps.label: Verify and register
steps.human: Independently verify the candidate and its evidence, then activate a version only with the required permission. Failed or incompatible candidates stay unregistered and visible.
consumes: A candidate query plus verification material

steps.label: Resume the original need
steps.human:
Execute the accepted query for the waiting question, then return to shared attempt comparison. Later requests can reuse the registered version rather than rebuilding it.

Return the executed result to [the shared attempt comparison loop](docs/product-truth/flows/leafcutter/retrieve-project-knowledge.flow.json#compare), which compares attempts before advisory recording, combination and final sufficiency.

This step is reachable only with a verified admitted version. A rejected or failed candidate exits through the failure branch without execution.

Return this attempt and its limits to [shared attempt comparison](docs/product-truth/flows/leafcutter/retrieve-project-knowledge.flow.json#compare) alongside prior or complementary methods. The main route owns comparison, advisory recording and combination once.

branches.label: Stop a rejected build
branches.human: Do not register or execute the rejected candidate. Preserve its failure, original need and prior evidence; return to [method selection](docs/product-truth/flows/leafcutter/retrieve-project-knowledge.flow.json#plan) for a permitted alternative when useful work/budget remains, otherwise report partial or blocked.

provenance.note:
Target design — not a delivery claim
User-requested question-first design. This flow is spec/draft; existing runtime and test evidence do not establish this full contract. Existing acceptance criteria are context pending behavioral mapping, not new completion proof.

Traversal and multiple-method design extension
Added bounded method selection/return routes and a shared attempt-comparison handoff. Target specification only; no runtime or acceptance-status change.
